description: A genus/version code, a KERI 1.0 inception body whose v field is a legacy 1.XX version string (KERI10JSON, size in six lowercase hex digits, terminator '_'), then a genus 2.00 attachments group holding one signature. Version 2.XX implementations must still support this version string format.
title: Frame a KERI 1.0 JSON inception by its legacy 1.XX version string
